name: Biological Science PhD

applicationFee.note: International degree applicants: $70. Qualifying degrees/affiliations only; confirm eligibility. See central policy. International applicants should confirm the applicable category and documentation before payment.

english.note: PTE 58. Official scores within two years; qualifying country/recent-degree exemptions. Department may require more.

requirements.note: Faculty sponsor required; contact potential advisers before applying. Regular undergraduate GPA 3.0; provisional routes exist for lower GPAs. Unofficial transcripts accepted for application; final official records by end of first semester.

funding.note: GTA/GRA opportunities; no universal funding guarantee. Undated GTA rate $2,262/month for 4.5-month fall/spring appointments, with tuition and health plan. Out-of-state tuition first year only; later in-state tuition. GRAs depend on adviser grants and typically cover tuition; student fees may remain.
